text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: One day, I catch sight of Tosen Jordan as I'm walking by the dance studio.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: All right! Not a single mistake!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Hey, keep your voice down! I'm making a video here!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Saying that, she walks over to her phone to stop recording.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Whatever, it's fine. I guess I can just cut the bit with you talking. I'll upload it later.
choice_data_list: I thought you were practicing for winning concerts.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Nah, I was making stuff for UmaTok.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: I mean, it's kinda like practice, right? I can't afford to be cringe when I'm dancing.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: There's, like, so many good dancers, you know? Everyone is sooo cute!
choice_data_list: Well, you can't let them outdo you!
Well, you can't let them outdo you!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: There's, like, so many good dancers, you know? Everyone is sooo cute!
choice_data_list: Well, you can't let them outdo you!
Well, you can't let them outdo you!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Hold on. Don't go projecting onto me, okay? That's not what this is about.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: And hold up. The way you said that, it's almost like…

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: You make it sound like I'm losing right now… or whatever…

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Ah… never mind! Anyway, show's over. Get out!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: As I'm leaving, I hear her mutter, "Just you watch!" But I decide not to mention that I heard anything.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: What's up with you all of a sudden? I don't need you to flatter me.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Cut it out already! Enough! You're making it super awkward!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Go and stand over there! I can't focus!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Tosen Jordan makes a bit of a commotion at first, but she follows it up with some sharp dance moves.
